summary: The PR addresses the issue of an empty __all__ attribute being ignored by marking all members as skipped when __all__ is an empty list. The addition of the reproduce.py script is useful for demonstration but not necessary for the core fix.

issues.description: The inclusion of numerous static CSS files and build artifacts (like .buildinfo and .doctrees files) in the diff is unnecessary and adds to the scope of the PR. These files should not be included in the source code repository.

The new reproduce.py script uses subprocess calls to install and build the documentation, which may not follow the project's preferred method of testing. It could be more idiomatic to use a testing framework or a separate script outside the source tree.
